e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Deliberately NOT part of `affected` and NOT referenced by any target's dependsOn or by targetDefaults — it runs ONLY on an explicit `nx run apigen-plugin-cli-output:e2e` (nx affected never selects it). It runs the sibling run-cli-integration.e2e.ts suite via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is exactly the resource prerequisites those tests need: `build` (the parity harness require()s this package's real built dist/index.js) and `apigen-cli:build` (the run-integration tests execFile the real built entrypoint/apigen-cli/dist/index.js).
